displayname: BBC Good Food - Quick recipes cookbook
description: For those moments when you need food on the table in double-quick time. Over 195 recipes that go from hob to plate in less than 30 minutes. Fancy some Quick lamb biryani? Could you be tempted by Parmesan spring chicken or how about a White chocolate & berry pudding? They can all be on your table in 30 minutes or less! Once you've downloaded the app, you can use and search the recipes at any time, even offline.
